# E135 -- Burger King

## Metadata
- **Brand:** Burger King
- **Industry:** QSR (Quick Service Restaurant)
- **Year:** 2020
- **Source file:** bb6ca332c3ffe7dba9fe8d75f24054d8.pdf
- **Designed by:** Jones Knowles Ritchie (JKR) -- implied by rebrand context
- **Scope:** Comprehensive brand identity guide (128+ pages) covering visual identity, verbal identity, illustration, legal standards, and file naming

## Brand Strategy
- **Positioning:** "Authenticity of food & people" -- in a world of standardization and fakeness, BK is a place where you can be who you are and enjoy food that is real, honest, and delicious
- **Creative idea:** "Your Way, Way Better" -- using design to close the gap between negative fast-food perceptions and the positive reality of BK's food story
- **Design principles (4):** Mouthwatering, Big & Bold, Playfully Irreverent, Proudly True
- **Heritage play:** Inspired by the brand's iconic 1969-1999 era logo; a mix of authentic past and new future
- **Goal:** Make brand and food feel less synthetic/artificial/cheap, more real/crave-able/tasty

## Logo
- **Primary logo:** Custom bun-shaped wordmark -- "BURGER KING" text sandwiched between two bun halves, paying homage to heritage logo
- **Small-use logo:** Simplified version for sizes 0.75 inch or less
- **Wordmark:** Horizontal text-only version for horizontal formats; should not be used alone without other branding
- **Favicon:** "BK" monogram designed for social media and small digital use; must never appear in alternate colorway
- **Clearspace:** Defined by the width of the "U" in "Burger" for both primary logo and wordmark
- **Minimum sizes:** Primary 0.5in / 40px; Wordmark 1.25in / 90px; Favicon 0.1875in / 17.5px
- **Signature lockups:** Whopper, Home of the Whopper, Flame Grilling Since 1954, Your Way (end-of-commercial lockup)
- **Chinese wordmark:** Custom Chinese characters created for local market with fixed proportions to primary logo
- **QR code:** Custom branded QR code design; minimum 1in print / 96px digital

## Typography
- **Primary typeface:** Flame -- bespoke typeface developed with Colophon Foundry, custom-created exclusively for Burger King
- **Weights/styles:** Flame Bold (headlines), Flame Regular (subheads), Flame Sans (body copy)
- **Character:** Rounded, organic letterforms inspired by the natural shapes of food -- "so mouthwateringly delicious, you can almost taste it"
- **Type hierarchy:** Subheads no larger than 50% of headline ascender height; body copy no larger than 50% of subhead cap height
- **Line height:** Set "square" -- line height equals point size (1:1 ratio); exception below 12pt (increase leading) and Flame Bold caps (decrease to 75%)
- **Caps usage:** Flame Bold all-caps allowed for layouts of 3 words or fewer
- **Ligatures and swashes:** Flame Bold and Regular contain ligatures; Bold also has stylistic alternates and discretionary swashes (use sparingly, only at beginning/end of words)
- **Regional alternatives:** Markets with unsupported scripts use approved alternatives (e.g., Fang Zheng family for Chinese)

## Color
- **Primary palette (3):**
  - Fiery Red -- #D62300 / PMS 2347
  - Flaming Orange -- #FF8732 / PMS 2018
  - BBQ Brown -- #502314 / PMS 4695
- **Secondary palette (3):**
  - Mayo Egg White -- #F5EBDC / PMS 9226
  - Crunchy Green -- #198737 / PMS 2426
  - Melty Yellow -- #FFAA00 / PMS 7549
- **Usage rules:** At least one primary color must appear in any BK branded application; secondary colors cannot be used on their own; three colorway tiers (primary, secondary, limited)
- **Don'ts:** No gradients, no modified brand colors, no previous brand identity colors, no distressing effects

## Graphics
- **Illustration system:** Four categories -- Storytelling, Stripes, Typography, Iconography
- **Style:** Custom illustration that is bold, organic, and food-centric; aligns with the "mouthwatering" and "playfully irreverent" design principles
- **Grid system:** Defined margin formula and margin construction; square-format layouts with specific layout examples provided

## Photography
- **Approach:** Macro photography with focus on details; big and bold; designed to create food craving
- **Style direction:** Confident and direct; plays with scale; colors are "unapologetically full and rich"
- **Logo on photography:** Uses Primary Logo with Background (Mayo Egg White backing) to retain legibility

## Applications
- **Scope:** Packaging, merchandising, menuboards, restaurant signage, social media, digital (including QR codes), out-of-home marketing, swag/merchandise, television commercials
- **Restaurant signage:** Special logo versions with white background for acrylic/plastic fabrication; softer lighting to emulate Mayo Egg White
- **Digital:** Favicon for social media; QR code for digital presence linking
- **Legal requirements:** All materials must go through MAAF (Digital Merchandising Advertising Approval Form) process; regional trademark clearance required

## Tone of Voice
- **Voice characteristics (4):** Enthusiastic, Confident, Witty, Approachable
- **Enthusiastic:** Unashamedly revels in food with bold, upbeat adjectives describing taste, look, texture; excited but not manic
- **Confident:** Bold and unafraid; proud of heritage ("Home of the Whopper," "Flame-grilled since 1954"); bold but not flashy
- **Witty:** Smart and quick; pokes fun at self and others; culturally aware without being try-hard; sarcastic but not cruel
- **Approachable:** Talks at eye level; simple, conversational, authentic language; clear not terse; real not pretentious
- **Verbal inspiration areas:** Talk about ingredients, talk about product, fire/flame-grilling, editorial/lifestyle, "Your Way" messaging
- **Extensive do/don't examples** for each characteristic with practical guidance

## Outliers
- **Bespoke QR code design** -- unusually detailed branding of what is typically a functional element
- **Chinese-specific adaptations** -- dedicated Chinese wordmark and logo lockup with clearspace rules (unusual depth for a single market)
- **Food-as-design-language philosophy** -- the entire visual identity is constructed as an extension of the food itself (colors named after ingredients, type described as "edible," illustrations as "mouthwatering")
- **Variable font:** Flame Bold Variable included for animated/digital use
- **Strict legal governance:** Multi-layered approval process (Global Brand Management + Legal + Regional teams) for all creative output

## Quality Score
**4 / 5** -- Extremely comprehensive and well-structured guide with clear hierarchy, extensive do/don't examples, and deep coverage of verbal + visual identity. The food-centric naming convention (Mayo Egg White, Crunchy Green, BBQ Brown) adds memorability and reinforces brand positioning. Loses a point for being somewhat repetitive with legal disclaimers on nearly every page, and the PDF text extraction suggests some pages are image-heavy without extractable content (illustration and photography sections likely rely on visuals not captured here).
